flavor: A circular chamber where the shadows do not behave; they pool like thick, viscous ink around the pedestals of headless statues. A heavy, unnatural silence presses against the eardrums, swallowing the sound of your own breathing.
name: The Void-Stained Reliquary
reason: The room contains a concentrated pocket of necrotic energy that empowers the guardians within, requiring a tactical engagement to prevent being overwhelmed by shadow-touched foes.
